## About
Angelo's Auto Body started with Angelo, who opened a tiny shop, moved to a bigger spot in Newark, and eventually settled in Irvington. Today his sons, brothers George and Nick Kostakis, run the shop and carry on what he cared about: quality work, fair pricing, and going the extra mile for each customer.
We handle collision repair, frame and alignment work, mechanical repairs, towing, and detailing for domestic and foreign vehicles. If you've been in an accident, you can drop your car off or have us pick it up, and we can take care of the details from there.
Our customers have given us a 4.3 rating from 186 Google reviews, and many of them say the same thing: we kept them updated and explained the work in plain terms.

## Services
- Collision repair: Repairs for collision damage on today's more complex vehicles, done in our own facility.
- Frame and alignment repairs: Straightening and alignment work after an accident.
- Mechanical service: A full service mechanical shop with a dealership-trained mechanic, at pricing that compares well with dealership rates.
- Computerized 4-wheel alignment: Wheel alignment done with computerized equipment.
- Brakes, struts and exhaust: Repair and replacement of brakes, struts and exhaust parts.
- Detailing and cosmetic repairs: Same day service for cosmetic repairs, paintless dent repair, shampooing and detailing. Detailing can also be done during collision repairs.
- Towing: Towing through our Rex Towing division, done with our flatbed wrecker.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with insurance companies?
A: Yes. We're an approved repair facility for over a dozen major insurance companies, and in most cases we can manage your claim for you.

Q: Who pays for the tow if it's an insurance claim?
A: If you need a tow as part of an insurance claim, the towing cost is covered as part of the overall cost of the repair.

Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We service both domestic and foreign vehicles.
